itens.trecho: Não é todos os dias que se faz história do cinema. Mas naquele dia 7 de Outubro de 1962 isso realmente aconteceu, com a estreia de Dr. No, o primeiro filme da longa franquia 007. No seu primeiro filme, o agente britânico vai às Bahamas para investigar o misterioso Dr.

The Americans are fools. I offered my services, they refused. So did the East. Now they can both pay for their mistake. Dr. No is directed by Terence Young and co-adapted to screenplay by Richard Maibaum, Johanna Harwood & Berkely Mather from the novel of the same name written by Ian Fleming.

Say YES to “Dr. No” After an MI6 chief & his secretary are murdered in Jamaica, agent 007 (Sean Connery) is sent to investigate. He teams-up with a boatman (John Kitzmiller) with focus on a mysterious nearby island owned by a shady German-Chinese mogul (Joseph Wiseman).
